scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:reset && npm run test:e2e:run
scripts.test:e2e:reset: docker compose -f ../docker-compose.yml exec -T backend php artisan migrate:fresh --seed
scripts.test:e2e:run: docker run --rm --network host --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -v "$(pwd):/app" -w /app -e E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:5183 -e HOME=/tmp mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble npx playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:ui: docker run --rm --network host --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -v "$(pwd):/app" -w /app -e E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:5183 -e HOME=/tmp mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble npx playwright test --ui-host=127.0.0.1 --ui-port=9324
scripts.test:e2e:headed: docker run --rm --network host -e DISPLAY -v /tmp/.X11-unix:/tmp/.X11-unix:ro -v "$(pwd):/app" -w /app -e E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:5183 -e HOME=/tmp mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble npx playwright test --headed --workers=1; status=$?; sh e2e/scripts/fix-report-ownership.sh; exit $status
scripts.test:e2e:headed:slow: docker run --rm --network host -e DISPLAY -v /tmp/.X11-unix:/tmp/.X11-unix:ro -v "$(pwd):/app" -w /app -e E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:5183 -e PW_SLOWMO="${PW_SLOWMO:-1500}" -e HOME=/tmp mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble npx playwright test --headed --workers=1; status=$?; sh e2e/scripts/fix-report-ownership.sh; exit $status
scripts.test:e2e:report: docker run --rm --network host --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -v "$(pwd):/app" -w /app -e HOME=/tmp mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble npx playwright show-report
